profile.headline: Senior Principal Software Engineer @Microsoft Delta (FDE) Team • Lecturer • Advisor
profile.summary:
As a Senior Principal Software Engineer in Microsoft’s Forward Deployment Engineering (FDE) Delta team, I build AI-native systems alongside some of the world’s most advanced organizations, partnering deeply on high-stakes, high-complexity deployments where edge cases are the norm.

My work sits at the intersection of software engineering, applied research, and production delivery always grounded in a strong ROI-driven mindset. Focus on building things that matters at scale.

I can convert messy requirements into clear plans and shipped results. Always ready to lead, unblock execution, and raise engineering quality. Outside of work, I teach in Northwestern’s MSAI program and mentor builders working on applied AI.

🔍 Explore my blog: https://pabloaicorner.hashnode.dev
🔧 Check out my GitHub: https://github.com/pablosalvador10

positions.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer @Microsoft Delta Team
positions.description:
Forward Deployment Engineering Delta is Microsoft’s small, senior engineering group that works side-by-side with the most advanced customers to turn frontier ideas into production reality. We build end-to-end across the full stack, shipping AI systems that are secure, reliable, and scalable under real constraints, and we feed those hard-earned edge cases back into the platform to shape product direction. 

The job is simple to describe and hard to do: take the toughest, highest-impact problems, deliver working software, and leave behind reusable patterns that raise the bar for everyone.

positions.title: Senior Principal AI Application Development Architect — Global Black Belt Team (AI Apps)
positions.description:
I’m a Senior Principal in Microsoft’s Global Black Belt AI Apps team, a small applied engineering group that designs and scales the most strategic AI systems on Azure for highly regulated, innovative global customers. I lead the strategy and architecture for agentic AI platforms: multi-agent and workflow-driven systems, real-time and multimodal experiences, and large-scale GenAI applications built on Azure AI and Azure OpenAI.

My role sits between the C-suite agenda and engineering reality. I work directly with CIOs, VPs, and chief architects to decide how AI fits into their core application landscape—data and retrieval, orchestration and tools, safety, compliance, and observability—and then stay close to the stack to turn those decisions into running systems. A big part of my impact is codifying what works into reusable reference architectures, accelerators, and patterns that help customers and internal teams take agentic AI to production at scale.

positions.title: Principal AI Application Development Architect – Global Black Belt Team (Azure AI)
positions.description:
I was a senior technical leader in Microsoft’s Global Black Belt AI Apps team, focusing on designing and deploying advanced Generative AI systems for some of the world’s most innovative companies and most regulated industries. My work combined deep AI/ML engineering with end-to-end architecture to deliver scalable, secure, and enterprise-ready solutions on Azure AI and Azure OpenAI.

I partnered with Fortune 500 enterprises and high-growth AI startups to solve complex problems using RAG, agentic systems (including Agentic RAG), and multi-agent orchestration. Day to day, I operated as both AI architect and full-stack engineer—building real applications where orchestration patterns, communication flows, and memory systems were well defined and tightly integrated with Azure cloud services. Beyond individual projects, I helped shape Azure AI usage by driving best practices, influencing product direction, and sharing patterns across teams.

positions.title: Adjunct Lecturer - Cloud Computing & AI
positions.description: As an Adjunct Instructor in Northwestern University's Master of Science in Artificial Intelligence (MSAI) program, I teach a hands-on, immersive curriculum in Cloud Computing and AI. My classes focus on building practical cloud and AI engineering skills, with a strong emphasis on Microsoft Azure

positions.title: Assistant Professor - Data Science
positions.description: I teach in the Master’s program in Data Science at Escuela de Ingeniería Julio Garavito, where I have the opportunity to do so in my native language, Spanish. My work focuses on guiding students through the full spectrum of artificial intelligence — from foundational concepts to advanced applications. I emphasize practical learning, showing how to design, build, and deploy intelligent agents and AI solutions within the Azure ecosystem, connecting theory with real-world implementation.

company.name: Escuela Colombiana de Ingeniería Julio Garavito

positions.title: Principal Machine Learning Engineer (Global Tech Lead)
positions.description:
Leading ML Engineering vertical where I have the opportunity to build exciting ML solutions to improve our Americas, Europe and SAMEA business building an exiting across-continents, global data community. I am responsible for owning and delivering projects end-to-end establishing high standards in performance, scalability, enterprise system architecture, ML/MLOps and software engineering best practices. To be more precise, I lead the architecture, development, maintenance, and improvements of new and existing suite of ML algorithms and their underlying systems. Implementing end-to-end solutions for batch and real-time algorithms along with requisite tooling around monitoring, logging, automated testing, performance testing and A/B testing. 

As a team leader, I have the chance to extend my ML engineering, software engineering, algorithm/systems design, cloud architecture into part mentor, part individual contributor and part advisor role. Mentoring a team of extraordinary ML engineers, Data Engineers and Software engineers fostering career growth through my expertise.

positions.description: Leading MLops Engineering practice. Principal Expert on Machine learning engineering and Data Science. Demonstrated experience with Spark,Hadoop (Big Data), AWS/Azure, Model building and deployment on Production Systems.
